instruction.text:
Marcus is hosting a bake sale at school to raise money for charity. He sells 105 cupcakes on Monday, 75 on Tuesday and 150 on Friday. He needs help to put the total number of sales into a pictogram.

First, drag the pictures to show the number of cupcakes he sells on Monday.
